name: BoundedContext
summary: Delimits where one model applies. Inside it every term has exactly one meaning; outside it the model makes no claim at all, and the same word may name something else entirely.

roles.name: BoundedContext
roles.summary: The boundary of one model. Everything the assembly declares belongs to that model, and a term used here means what this model says it means — which is why a second model in the same assembly is not a boundary but a collision.
